description: This file is a shell script for testing receive input limits in a Git repository setup. It defines functions to validate object store types and tests various push scenarios with different input size limits and configurations.

methods.name: validate_store_type
methods.description: Validates the type of object store in the destination repository based on the 'store_type' parameter, checking output for 'index' or 'unpack' scenarios.

methods.name: test_pack_input_limit
methods.description: Runs a series of tests with a specified store type ('index' or 'unpack'), manipulating limit settings and verifying push behaviors and object store states.
